unauthorized_trials: All downloads, installs and cloud/provider tests require separate exact authorization. None are authorized.

thresholds.substantial_gain: semantic exactness +2 percentage points OR warm p95 latency -30%; no new critical errors, WER/CER regression <=1 percentage point, all privacy/ops hard constraints satisfied

decision_rule: No REPLACE without all bound measurements, privacy, license/security and rollback. No KEEP solely because challengers were not tested. Missing fair comparison => ASR DECISION BLOCKED.
quality_rule: language_probability is language evidence only. No calibrated word/semantic probability. All ASR transcripts require owner confirmation until benchmark-validated quality policy exists.
limits_of_evidence: 16 synthetic TTS cases are a pilot corpus, not representative human Russian speech. Voice parity with fixture compiler is integration evidence, not measured real-compiler semantic accuracy. Noise is deterministic and synthetic. Mandatory wider corpus and actual comparator remain qualification gaps.
